title: Project Manager
description:
Position: Project Manager
Location: New York City
Terms: 12 Months


Primary Responsibilities:
  • Revamp complete suite of PMO templates aligned with SDLC phases
  • Develop comprehensive "PM Starter Pack" including templates, guides, best practices, checklists, examples, and starter project plans
  • Redesign templates: Project Charters, Project Plans, RAID Logs, Decision Logs, RACI matrices, Change Request forms, Scope Management Plans, Resource Management templates, Status Reports, Cost Estimates, Deployment Plans, and Support Models
  • Build standardized starter project plans with pre-populated tasks, deliverables, milestones, and dependencies for different project types using the SDLC phases
  • Develop Program and Project Governance Plans establishing best practices for all project sizes
  • Create tiered governance frameworks based on project budget and complexity (i.e., oversight and organizational framework)

Quality Assurance Support & Project Evaluation (30%)
  • Participate in QA activities evaluating projects against SDLC compliance requirements
  • Conduct QA assessments verifying project management documentation completeness and business approvals
  • Evaluate projects using established rating criteria
  • Review project management artifacts: Charters, Plans, RAID Logs, RACI matrices, Decision Logs, Scope Plans, Change Control, and Resource Management documents
  • Provide observations and actionable recommendations to project teams
  • Identify documentation gaps and process deficiencies
  • Track QA results and trends across portfolio
  • Contribute to monthly QA summary reports

Portfolio Liaison Upskilling & QA Capability Building (30%)
  • Train Portfolio Liaisons on quality project management and effective QA practices
  • Deliver training on "what good looks like" for essential PM artifacts
  • Create job aids: QA checklists, evaluation criteria, "Good vs. Poor" examples, quick reference guides, and evaluation rubrics
  • Provide hands-on coaching during QA activities
  • Facilitate workshops for practicing artifact evaluation
  • Enable Portfolio Liaisons to perform independent QA reviews
  • Build capability to provide constructive feedback and project coaching
  • Support development of PMO processes for portfolio monitoring and governance

Qualifications:
Required Education & Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or related field
  • 10+ years progressive project and program management experience
  • Proven IT project governance and SDLC oversight experience
  • Demonstrated success developing PM standards, templates, and methodologies
  • Experience conducting QA reviews and process improvements
  • Experience with large-scale programs (>$20M preferred)
  • Experience training or mentoring PM professionals

Technical Skills - Must Have
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification required
  • Expert knowledge of PM methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, Hybrid)
  • Deep understanding of SDLC phases and governance requirements
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Project and Microsoft Office Suite
  • Strong experience with project planning, RACI matrices, RAID logs, decision logging, change control, scope management, resource planning, and governance frameworks
  • Exceptional template design and documentation skills
  • Experience developing training materials and job aids

Technical Skills - Nice to Have
  • Power BI for dashboard development
  • SharePoint site development and customization
  • Microsoft Teams
  • Data and Analytics capabilities
  • Azure DevOps (ADO)
  • PPM Tool (i.e., Oracle, Planview, etc.)
  • Organizational Change Management (OCM)
  • Utility or energy industry experience
  • Instructional design principles
  • Program Management Professional (PgMP) certification

title: Data Scientist
description:
Data Scientist

skills
AWS, Data Scientist, Snowflake, SQL


Required Education & Experience
• Education: A Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, etc.). Internship experience is considered valid.
• Experience: 1-2 years of professional experience utilizing quantitative analysis.

Technical Skills:
o SQL: Proficiency in writing queries for data extraction.
o Cloud Data Platforms: Experience with AWS and Snowflake.
o Data Visualization: Strong skills in Power BI for building dashboards.
• Soft Skills: Strong initiative, interpersonal skills, and the ability to communicate effectively.

Nice-to-Have (Top Candidate Qualifiers)
• A Master's or PhD in a highly relevant field (Data Science, Predictive Analytics, Applied Statistics, etc.).
• Experience with other cloud technologies (Azure, Google Cloud).
• Evidence of continuous learning in the analytics field.
• Experience with Power Apps.

Key Responsibilities
• Data Extraction & Analysis: Write SQL queries to extract data and analyze trends to support business needs.
• Dashboard & Tool Development: Build, maintain, and revise Power BI dashboards and database schemas.
• Data Validation: Ensure the accuracy and integrity of datasets used for supply chain analytics.
• Collaboration: Work closely with a team of data scientists and management to understand requirements and deliver effective data visualizations and solutions.
• Project Participation: Join cross-functional teams to solve problems presented by internal business units, dealers, or customers.

Disqualifiers / Red Flags
• Candidates who are overqualified (e.g., Senior Data Scientists with 8+ years of experience) or who lack the required hands-on technical skills in SQL, AWS, and Power BI will not be a good fit.

Role Context & Team Dynamics
• Team Structure: You will be part of a small team of 5 employees.
• Work Environment: This is a full-time, on-site position in Mossville, IL. There is no remote work possibility.
• Typical Task Breakdown: The role is heavily focused on the technical execution of data tasks—writing SQL, building Power BI reports, and managing data schemas. You will coordinate with management to understand the desired "views " for dashboards
and collaborate with other data scientists on technical implementation.
• Value Proposition: This role offers the opportunity to be part of a transformation team, driving new processes and tools within a global industrial leader. It provides excellent experience in applying data science to real-world supply chain challenges.

title: ITAM Governance Lead
description:
Job Title: ITAM Governance Lead
Location: Hybrid – 60% Onsite in Houston
Terms: C2H role - Potential for full-time conversion after 6 months based on performance.

Key "Must-Have” Skills:
  • ITAM Governance Framework - 10+ years
  • ITAM Governance Process and Procedures - 10+ years
  • ITAM Subject Matter Expertise - 10+ years

"Nice-to-Have” Skills:
  • ITIL Certification
  • ITAMF Certification
  • ITITAM Certification - CSAM, CHAMP, CITAM, CITAD

Ideal Candidate Profile: An experienced IT Asset Management professional with a strategic mindset and a passion for operational excellence. The ideal candidate can drive governance initiatives, influence cultural change, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure ITAM compliance and efficiency.

Summary of Job Description:
The ITAM Governance Lead will action the emerging CRBG ITAM Standard by establishing the CRBG ITAM Governance Framework. This role involves developing and enforcing ITAM Governance Process and Procedures, and collaborating with Procurement, Finance, IT Security, and Legal to define ownership, accountability, and compliance metrics. The lead will design KPIs and reporting for asset performance, contract utilization, software licensing, and vendor compliance. The successful candidate will also serve as an ITAM Subject Matter Expert (SME) for enterprise architecture, transformation programs, and IT control audits.

Strong Selling Points of the Role/Company:
Opportunity to establish and drive a new ITAM Governance Framework for a major enterprise.
Potential for full-time conversion after 6 months based on performance.

Job Responsibilities:
  • Establish an ITAM Governance Framework and develop corresponding processes and procedures.
  • Collaborate across various departments to define ownership, accountability, and compliance metrics.
  • Design and implement KPIs and reporting for asset performance, contract utilization, and vendor compliance.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for transformation programs and operational initiatives.

Ideal Candidate with below skills:
  • Action emerging Customer Information Technology Asset Management (ITAM) standards by standing up the Customer ITAM Governance Framework.
  • Develop and enforce ITAM Governance Process and Procedures for ITAM governance across the enterprise.
  • Support Procurement, Finance, IT Security and Legal to define ownership, accountability and compliance metrics.
  • Design Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and reporting for asset performance, contract utilization, software licensing and vendor compliance.
  • Serve as ITAM Subject Matter Advisory (SMA) to Enterprise Architecture, transformation programs, operational initiative, Infrastructure and Finance cost-optimization efforts and IT Control Audits

title: IA-DOM-DOIT-PM6-Project Manager
description:
Limit submittals to local/regional candidates who can work onsite 2-3 days/week. Agencies who misrepresent a candidates location will be disqualified from the selection process.
The Division of Information Technology (DoIT) provides adaptable, secure, and cost-effective technology services and solutions for the Department of Management [DOM] and its Partners. We manage all State of Iowa Executive Branch IT assets, projects, and resources, as well as providing technology and expertise to support Iowa's citizens and families. DOM DoIT does this by consistently delivering top tier performance and value to citizens as a trusted partner and service provider.
DoIT is committed to the pursuit of creative and innovative solutions that enable our agency to help Iowans achieve healthy, safe, stable, and self-sufficient lives through the programs and services we provide. We strive for an IT culture that identifies the newest, most effective solutions through discovery, open discussion and collaboration. We have fun together, care about each other, and take pride in the solutions we provide. We believe in continuously optimizing our processes, refining our solutions, and improving ourselves for the benefit of the Iowans we serve.

The project manager will be responsible for adhering project management governance on multiple current and future projects. Additionally, the PM will be accountable for generating project schedules, identifying/staffing needed resourcing, completing the procurement of vendor products / implementation services, and submitting funding requests as required. The PM will manage the delivery efforts and report status of each within a common project reporting mechanism. The PM will work with multiple business and platform areas across the State, potentially including upper-level state government committees. The Project Manager will conduct project meetings and is responsible for project tracking and analysis, ensuring adherence to quality standards and project deliverables.
The PM will be part of a PMO team responsible for all aspects of IT project governance, assessment, management, and control. The ability to gather and define requirements; build a project plan; identifying resource needs; and transparent, clear communications across all levels of stakeholders. Essential is the ability to multi-task on continually changing and morphing priorities as prescribed by leadership in response to department and legislative direction.
Duties
  • Ability to work within a project governance structure (methodology, required templates and reporting)
  • Ability to interact with, educate, learn from, and drive business and IT teams.
  • Ability to work effectively under very broad direction with general supervision.
  • Ability to motivate team and meet deadlines in a fast-paced and challenging environment.
  • Ability to gather and organize multiple simultaneous complex business process scenarios.
  • Ability to break down complex tasks into actionable work items, sequenced appropriately.
  • Ability to manage scope creep with a focus on delivering a minimum viable product.
  • Excellent organizational, presentation, interpersonal and team building skills.
  • Excellent time management and project planning/strategizing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Demonstrated experience with managing client expectations, implementing service improvement initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple parallel work efforts.
  • Track project progress, monitor and modify project schedules and provide status updates to project team. Escalate issues to management and/or appropriate leadership as appropriate.
  • Provide insight and knowledge into improving processes related to portfolio, project and program management.
  • Other duties or tasks as assigned by management.


Required Skills
  • Direct management of system integration projects.
  • Experience managing stakeholder expectations and priorities.
  • Experience working within a project governance structure (methodology, required templates and reporting).
  • Extensive experience with planning, managing and tracking multiple major impact projects.
  • Strong process development skills, w/ the ability to learn and understand concepts in order to interpret, document and formalize procedures.
  • Strong process and gap analysis skills.
  • Excellent project management skills, w/ the ability to multitask and manage multiple tasks with changing priorities in a cross-functional environment.
  • Demonstrated experience with working with business users to gather and document business requirements.
  • Demonstrate ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and project activities simultaneously while meeting established deadlines.

title: Oracle Service Cloud (OSvC) Consultant
description:
Job Title: Oracle Service Cloud (OSvC) Consultant
Location: Remote
Maximum Expected Travel: 20% - Company will bear the expenses
Duration: 10-11 Months Contract


Responsibilities:
We are seeking an experienced Senior CX Cloud Consultant with experience in implementing Oracle CX Cloud and Oracle Mobile Application framework to join our practice. This is a hands on role focused on enhancing existing landscape for the customer and working closely with our customers with routine reviews on suggestions and solutions. Candidate must be proficient in solution design, business process analysis, configuration, testing and system integration. This is a remote position.

Responsibilities:
  • Serve as the senior developer for Oracle Service Cloud (OSvC), leading the design, development, and implementation of technical solutions.
  • Own and deliver technical features, enhancements, and user stories that align with business objectives and client needs.
  • Evaluate the impact of proposed changes and recommend scalable, efficient solution improvements.
  • Lead technical workshops, demonstrations, and working sessions, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams and clients.
  • Prepare, maintain, and review detailed system documentation, including technical specifications and user guides.
  • Monitor and analyze agent and system performance to identify gaps, optimize efficiency, and improve overall service delivery.
  • Provide data-driven insights through ad hoc reporting, analytics, and performance dashboards to support business decisions and success metrics.
  • Design and maintain custom reports and dashboards tailored to stakeholder needs.
  • Perform application administration tasks, including user and role management, configuration updates, data rules, and feature activations.
  • Enhance and maintain mobile applications for iOS and Android using the Oracle Mobile Application Framework (Oracle MAF).
  • Continuously assess client operations, recommend CX best practices, and drive measurable improvements in efficiency and effectiveness.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 10+ years of hands-on development experience with Oracle Service Cloud (OSvC), including deep knowledge of Oracle APIs.
  • Proven track record delivering end-to-end OSvC implementations, including at least three full project lifecycles (preferred).
  • Experience designing and building custom solutions using the OSvC framework (.NET, JavaScript) and the Widget Framework (UI/UX layers).
  • Demonstrated expertise integrating OSvC with COTS platforms, middleware, and cloud telephony solutions (e.g., Genesys, IVR, SMS, CTI toolbars).
  • Proficiency in integration technologies such as SOAP and REST APIs in the context of Oracle Service Cloud (RightNow CX).
  • Strong background performing root-cause analysis, technical troubleshooting, and data migration for complex environments.
  • Oracle Service Cloud certification (preferred).
  • Familiarity with Oracle Mobile Application Framework (Oracle MAF) considered a plus.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • In-depth knowledge of OSvC components: Agent Desktop, Workspaces & Workflows, CPM, Agent Scripting, Knowledge Management, Rules, UI customization, Analytics, Custom Objects, and ROQL.
  • Understanding of Oracle Service Cloud architecture layers, specifically OIA, OSvC, and UI/UX (Widget Framework).
  • Skilled in extending, customizing, and developing Oracle Service Cloud widgets for Chat, Knowledge, and Email.
  • Strong grasp of Oracle Policy Automation (Intelligent Automation), Knowledge Advanced, Social Relationship Management, and Oracle Mobile Service Cloud/Chat Bot functionality.
  • Ability to configure and manage Oracle/RightNow CX components, business rules, and integrations across systems.
  • Experience designing and documenting business processes, solution architecture, testing, and user training.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities for identifying performance gaps and optimizing system efficiency.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with proven success collaborating across business and technical teams.
  • Capable of handling complex UI customization and integrations involving multiple systems.
